root_cause: MAX_TOKENS truncation before complete sentinel token emission
diagnosis: Credential, model, live-enable marker, and network-approval marker were present in the operator run.
Local dry-run mapping, structured-output dry-run, tool-calling dry-run, safety fixture, and redaction checks passed.
The live provider response was truncated before the expected sentinel strings were fully emitted.
The trace showed Gemini thinking token usage before a short candidate output, which makes the previous text canary default maxOutputTokens too small for Gemini 3 thinking models.
fix_applied: Text canary default maxOutputTokens increased from 32 to 128.
Gemini 3 text canary requests now use generationConfig.thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel=minimal by default unless overridden.
Gemini 2.5 Flash text canary requests now use generationConfig.thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget=0 by default unless overridden.
Live runner now records a MAX_TOKENS failure detail when provider output truncates.
